projects.settings.fallback: Allow the model to propose when no rule matches
projects.settings.dangerHint: Every switch needs your explicit consent; the plugin never turns one on by itself.
projects.settings.danger.forcePushOwnBranch.label: Allow force-pushing your own dsh/ branches
projects.settings.danger.forcePushOwnBranch.risk: Uses --force-with-lease bound to the expected SHA; refuses when the remote moved, the branch is protected, or the old SHA is unknown, and records the old SHA for recovery.
projects.settings.danger.pushProtectedBranch.labe: Allow pushing directly to default/protected branches
projects.settings.danger.pushProtectedBranch.risk: Requires a per-repo grant in the project policy; checks protection/rulesets first and refuses when the server requires a PR; every push is audited and multi-collaborator repos raise a warning.
projects.settings.danger.autoMerge.label: auto-merge PRs
projects.settings.danger.autoMerge.risk: merging is irreversible (revert only); still gated by diff limits and human approval
projects.settings.danger.trashAuto.label: auto archive/delete into trash
projects.settings.danger.trashAuto.risk: moves content into trash/; restorable from manifest, but not free
projects.settings.danger.purgeAfterRetention.labe: Allow purging the trash after the retention period
projects.settings.danger.purgeAfterRetention.risk: Only touches entries already in the trash that exceed the retention period; writes a purge manifest first; dry-run by default, real deletion needs explicit confirmation.
projects.settings.danger.editProfile.label: edit project policy itself
projects.settings.danger.editProfile.risk: the coordinator could loosen its own limits; highest risk

projects.detail.purgeHint: Only purges entries in this project's trash that are **past the retention period**; preview first, then confirm. Requires the purgeAfterRetention switch.
